{"action":"final","query":{"op":"none","scope":null,"id":null,"text":null,"start":null,"end":null,"offset":null,"derived_op":null,"groupBy":null},"diagnosis":"The selective log-softmax kernel assumes unit token strides for IDs and masks and incorrectly uses the ID batch stride to index the mask. Independent suffix slices can have different batch strides; strided and broadcast views also require their own token strides, including zero. Observed grpo-01 has ID strides [10,1] and mask strides [16,1], producing 7/21 mismatches with maximum absolute error 5.350447. The dense control grpo-00 uses [7,1] for both, passes all 21 outputs, and has maximum absolute error 3.244e-7. Both observations report unchanged inputs. The patch passes and uses both strides independently for each sliced tensor, preserving suffix offsets, FP32 output, masked zeros, and the existing numerical computation. With mask=None, unused mask strides are zero.
